name: openclash
description: OpenClash (mihomo/Clash client with a LuCI UI) as a one-click plugin

packages.name: wharf-openclash
packages.description:
OpenClash with everything it needs (meta package)
Installs luci-app-openclash plus the LuCI base it requires. On any OpenWrt, open LuCI > Services > OpenClash afterwards.

packages.name: wharf-glinet-openclash
packages.description:
OpenClash for GL.iNet 4.x firmware
Adds an OpenClash entry under Applications in the GL.iNet admin panel, pulls in OpenClash and LuCI, and keeps /etc/openclash across firmware upgrades.
